messages:
Maya (SRE): FYI - canary for kg-serializer is seeing ~5% 500s and increased p95 after the tokenizer change. Reverting is easiest but we have a quick patch in PR #3421. Need expedited approval to push hotfix during change window. Details: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3421
Tom (eng-infra): +1 to fix. Can you paste the minimal diff? Any DB migration?
Maya (SRE): No DB changes. Diff is a 2-line revert in serializer.py that avoids new buffer path. Snippet:
```diff
- use_new_buffer = True
+ use_new_buffer = False
```
PR includes tests and canary-only rollout plan.
Raj (eng-runtime): Do we need pinning? If new binary built, we should pin canary to v1.15.3-hotfix and have rollback tag ready: v1.15.2-stable. I can cut the image now if approved.
DeployBot: deploy queued by @Maya (SRE) to cluster inference-eu for kg-serializer:v1.15.3-hotfix. Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% rollout. CI: ✅. Estimated downtime: none. Approvals required: 2 (eng, sres).
Emma (eng-releases): Approve from release side. :thumbsup: Please add release note blurb.
Tom (eng-infra): Approve. Also, make sure metrics alert muted is set for noisy alerts during the rollout.
Maya (SRE): Roger. I'll mute noisy test alerts for 30m. Rolling to 10% now.
DeployBot: Rollout started: kg-serializer:v1.15.3-hotfix -> 10% canary (group A).
Raj (eng-runtime): Watching logs. Early tail shows decreased 500s. ping me if any increase.
Maya (SRE): Canary at 10% looks good for 3m, moving to 50%.
DeployBot: Canary at 50% complete. Health checks: passed. p95 latency improved. 500s down to 0.8%.
Tom (eng-infra): I see metrics green. Recommend proceed.
Emma (eng-releases): Approved to promote to 100%.
Maya (SRE): Promoting to 100% now. Also updated rollout note: pinned to v1.15.3-hotfix across regions.
DeployBot: Rollout complete: 100% -> kg-serializer:v1.15.3-hotfix. Health: OK. Canary run logs: https://console.redwood/rollouts/1782003456
Raj (eng-runtime): Good. Tagging rollback command for ops: `kubectl set image deployment/kg-serializer kg-serializer=ghcr.io/redwood/kg-serializer:v1.15.2-stable --namespace=prod`
Tom (eng-infra): Added entry to release notes draft.
Release note: 'Fix kg-serializer regression causing intermittent 500s after tokenizer change; rolled out hotfix v1.15.3-hotfix.'
Maya (SRE): Thx team. Unmuting alerts in 5m. I'll open a retro card to track root cause.
DeployBot: Deployment annotation: expedited-hotfix; approvals: Emma, Tom; started_by: Maya (SRE); duration: 8m.
